name: msc-music-app
description: MSC Music — müzik ekosistemi mobil uygulaması (Capacitor / Android)

scripts.sync: npm run build:www && npx cap sync android
scripts.assemble:debug: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.bundle:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.apk:release: npm run sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
